title: Wire semantic benchmarks to the embedding provider
description: Deep-dive audit 2026-08-08 verified that ordinary semantic benchmark tests construct MemoryApplicationService without SemanticEmbeddingSearchService, so they exercise token fallback while being named semantic. Evidence: MemorySmith.Tests/SearchBenchmarkTests.cs lines 88-1116. Inject the real provider for model-backed cases, assert provider metadata, and name fallback tests separately.
